evidence: coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:2601-2650 pins checkpoint_files after accepting the correlated SaveDataUpdated, but gives the absolute deadline first priority and returns CheckpointTimeout directly; the pinned checkpoint future is then dropped.

coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:2640-2646 also propagates reset/control/realtime terminal errors with ? while checkpoint_files is in flight, likewise dropping the transaction instead of latching the terminal until reconciliation.

coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:3000-3003 documents the existing invariant: once prepare starts, idempotent retries and heartbeat fencing must finish because cancellation can leave a committed snapshot with stale local revision.

coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:5678-5738 proves only a deadline while waiting for the sidecar correlation events; it never emits CommandResult or SaveDataUpdated and therefore never enters the ambiguous cloud transaction being cancelled by the new branch.
findings.impact: If the deadline, a reset, or a realtime/control terminal arrives after prepare/finalize has been sent, the launcher can abandon an ambiguous checkpoint and tear down with a stale local revision even though the server may commit it. That violates the noncancellable checkpoint and post-reconciliation terminal-ordering guarantees and can strand the next session behind an unexplained revision conflict.
findings.observation: The pre-activation realtime checkpoint path cancels checkpoint_files after the cloud transaction may have begun, rather than latching terminal state and reconciling the checkpoint before teardown.
findings.recommendation: Keep the absolute deadline on grant/save correlation and the local correlated-save wait, but once the cloud prepare phase can begin, let checkpoint_files and its idempotent retries run to a conclusive result. During that phase, drain realtime/control only into bounded buffers or a sticky terminal flag, then handle the terminal immediately after reconciliation. Add a deterministic test that delays finalize beyond the correlation deadline, makes deadline/reset/realtime terminal ready after prepare, and proves the committed revision is installed before the terminal result is returned.

evidence: coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:5390-5417 queues only two realtime events (Ready and one Spawn), then deliberately prevents the realtime terminal until all four booleans have already been observed.

coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:5422-5430 supplies only a finite 256-event control burst, and lines 5453-5507 merely assert that each source was observed eventually; there is no barrier proving control, realtime, and heartbeat were continuously ready at the same arbitration points.

The r2 defect was specifically the old scheduler repeating control plus realtime forever while starving heartbeat. This test would still terminate after the finite realtime/control inputs drain, so it is not a deterministic regression oracle for that simultaneous-all-ready failure mode.
findings.impact: The new rotation is structurally sound, but the required all-ready regression can pass if future changes restore the exact multi-source starvation pattern fixed in r3.
findings.observation: The test named active_round_robin_advances_control_realtime_heartbeat_and_terminal does not actually hold all three service sources ready together or assert a bounded selection order.
findings.recommendation: Use synchronized mock futures or sustained producers with an explicit readiness barrier so Control, Realtime, and an already-due Heartbeat are all ready before polling. Assert the exact bounded C/R/H rotation (and separately Ready-to-Activate priority) rather than eventual booleans after finite producers drain.
